summary: Implemented critical SurrealDB-first data architecture in template storage operations. Resolved 2 of 3 conflicts (CONFLICT-002, CONFLICT-003). CONFLICT-001 requires additional refactoring of record_execution_result().

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Added SurrealDB write BEFORE Redis cache write with proper error handling
componentsUpdated.reason: Establishes SurrealDB as primary storage. Templates now persist across Redis restarts.

technicalDetails.before: Only wrote to Redis cache (data loss on Redis flush)
technicalDetails.after: Writes to SurrealDB first, then Redis cache with TTL. SurrealDB errors are fatal, Redis errors are non-fatal.
technicalDetails.errorHandling: SurrealDB failure prevents caching (fail-fast). Redis failure logged as warning (non-fatal).

componentsUpdated.resolvesConflict: CONFLICT-003 - Missing SurrealDB Write in Template Creation

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Implemented cache-aside pattern with SurrealDB fallback on cache miss
componentsUpdated.reason: Ensures templates accessible after cache eviction or Redis restart
